# fresh-cbm

> Exact cached libcbm stand-state tables and lookup client for WS4/FEMIC carbon analyses.

## Start here

- [Home](index.html): the documentation home.
- [Context and target applications](guides/context.html): the problem, users, target applications, and non-goals.
- [Applications and worked example](guides/applications.html): TSA41, the consumer path, invalidation, and FAQ.
- [Cache format](guides/cache-format.html): manifest, index, values, and the state-not-blocks rule.
- [Building a cache](guides/building.html): builder, pilot, and exact validation.
- [Releasing a cache](guides/releasing.html): checksums, assets, and provenance.
- [Architecture and data flow](reference/architecture.html): builder, cache, consumer, identity, and fallback.
- [Validation contract](reference/validation.html): manifest and exactness requirements.
- [Maintenance and compatibility](reference/maintenance.html): review cadence, versioning, rebuild triggers, and triage.
- [API reference](api/index.html): the Python client and schema.

## API

- [fresh_cbm](api/fresh-cbm.html): state lookup client.
- [fresh_cbm.schema](api/schema.html): manifest schema validation.
- [fresh_cbm.family](api/family.html): declared chain-family contract.
- [fresh_cbm.effects](api/effects.html): block/fragment area-weighted effect projection.
- [fresh_cbm.benchmark](api/benchmark.html): cache load, lookup, projection, and storage measurements.
- [fresh_cbm.verify](api/verify.html): offline cache checksum and release verification.
- [Commands](api/commands.html): build, validate, and package entry points.
